note: Resource definitions for the resource map - floors are the low water marks a run should flag, sinks are the known spends, push sources are where more comes from. Values are judgement calls from play on 2026-10-25, to be tuned with the owner.

black_rock.label: Black rock resource (HUD second row, name unverified - Rare Soil or coal class)

coin.label: Coin (gold)
push_sources: intercity trucks, about 1.2M to 2.4M gold per truck
truck plunder, about 600K gold per UR truck
sinks: research - the largest sink at this level

food.label: Food
push_sources: intercity trucks, about 3.0M to 3.8M per truck
sinks: troop training batches, about 5.5M per T10 batch

gold_bars.label: Gold bars (HUD)
sinks: shop and upgrade uses, to verify

honor.label: Alliance honor points (Alliance Store currency, refreshes Monday 00:00 server time)
sinks: Alliance Store items - buying is an owner decision

iron.label: Iron
push_sources: intercity trucks, about 3.0M to 3.8M per truck
sinks: troop training batches, about 5.5M per T10 batch

stamina.label: Stamina (cap 120)
push_sources: free 75 claim at the radar, twice a day

titanium_alloy.label: Titanium alloy (blue crystal HUD resource, Season 2)

trade_contracts.label: Trade Contracts (items)
sinks: train tickets, 3 per boarding under the standing rule
truck refresh after the free one - never paid autonomously
